30 seconds | 16:9 | premium travel music video / fashion travel film | 2024–2026 commercial grade | MULTISHOT

CORE CONCEPT
A young traveler experiences China through an energetic but natural sequence of movement, culture, fashion, food, architecture and landscapes. The film feels like a premium Chinese tourism campaign combined with an elite fashion travel film. The traveler is always physically present in the environment. Every location feels photographed rather than generated. Music drives the edit, but the footage retains the imperfections and spontaneity of real travel photography.

CHARACTER
ONE TRAVELER — young adult international traveler wearing a contemporary Adidas travel outfit: premium red Adidas jacket, neutral trousers, sneakers, compact crossbody bag. Natural hair, realistic skin texture, minimal accessories. Same face, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and accessories throughout the entire film. Do not invent additional Adidas branding.

SETTING
Modern and historic China: high-speed railway, Shanghai streets, traditional water-town lanes, Chengdu food streets, ancient architecture, dramatic mountain valleys, elevated viewpoints and vibrant nighttime streets. Real pedestrians, vendors, commuters, vehicles and local activity. Locations feel naturally connected through the journey.

STORY — MUSIC-DRIVEN MULTISHOT VISUALS

00:00–02.5 — CLOSE-UP HOOK
85mm close-up of the traveler beside a high-speed train window. Warm sunlight catches the face while reflections of the moving Chinese landscape slide across the glass. Traveler looks outside, then turns toward camera as the first beat begins.

02.5–05 — MOVEMENT
24mm wide shot from the platform as the traveler walks alongside the departing high-speed train. Wind moves the red jacket naturally. The train accelerates through frame. Cut precisely with the music.

05–07.5 — CITY ARRIVAL
35mm handheld follow shot as the traveler exits a busy station into a dense Chinese city street. Real pedestrians cross naturally. Electric scooters, taxis and buses move through the background. Camera operator follows slightly behind rather than perfectly framing the subject.

07.5–10 — STREET LIFE
50mm observational shot. Traveler moves through a crowded neighborhood while a food vendor prepares steaming street food nearby. Traveler briefly stops, watches the preparation and smiles naturally. Steam passes across the foreground.

10–12.5 — CULTURAL TRANSITION
24mm shot following the traveler through a traditional Chinese water-town street. Stone paths, wooden buildings, bridges and hanging signs surround them. People move naturally through the scene. Traveler crosses a small bridge as sunlight breaks through the buildings.

12.5–15 — FOOD / HUMAN MOMENT
50mm close-up. A local vendor hands the traveler a freshly prepared dish. Traveler takes a bite and reacts naturally. Shallow depth of field, warm skin tones, authentic background activity and subtle handheld movement.

15–17.5 — MOUNTAIN REVEAL
24mm deep-focus landscape. Traveler walks up a long stone staircase through dense greenery. Camera follows from behind. As the traveler reaches the top, a vast mountain valley emerges through cool atmospheric mist.

17.5–20 — FASHION MOMENT
50mm side-tracking shot in golden sunlight. Traveler walks along the mountain viewpoint. Red Adidas jacket contrasts strongly against deep green vegetation. Golden rim light catches the hair and shoulders. Natural wind moves fabric.

20–22.5 — LANDSCAPE / SCALE
24mm wide. Traveler becomes small against enormous mountains disappearing into mist. Clouds move slowly through the valley. No artificial drone aesthetic; perspective feels like a real elevated camera position.

22.5–25 — NIGHT TRANSITION
50mm handheld street shot at blue hour. Traveler enters a lively nighttime food district. Warm lanterns, cool ambient light, scooters and pedestrians create layered depth. The music increases in intensity.

25–27.5 — CITY ENERGY
35mm tracking shot as traveler walks beside a modern riverside district. Reflections ripple across the water. Modern towers illuminate behind them while boats move naturally through the frame.

27.5–30 — FINAL REVEAL
24mm wide composition from behind the traveler. They stop briefly at the riverside and look across the illuminated skyline. Camera slowly moves backward rather than flying upward. Traveler then continues walking as the music reaches its final beat.

CAMERA
35mm and 50mm for portraits and human moments, 24mm for landscapes, architecture and stairs, occasional 85mm compression on faces. Shallow DOF on close-ups, deep focus on mountain wides. Handheld and physically motivated tracking movement. Natural camera micro-movement, imperfect framing, subtle autofocus adjustment, realistic exposure adaptation and occasional foreground obstruction. No impossible camera movement, no floating drone aesthetic.

VISUAL / COLOR SETTING
Premium travel music video / fashion travel film, 2024–2026 commercial grade. Look: photoreal cinema, slight filmic grain, mild halation on highlights, teal-cyan skies, punchy crimson reds, deep forest greens, warm skin, crushed-but-not-crushed blacks.

COLOR GRADE
Cinematic teal-and-warm, greens slightly cyan, red Adidas pops hard against foliage, golden rim on faces in sun, cool mist in mountain valleys. Maintain realistic skin tones and natural environmental color. No excessive saturation or artificial HDR.

MOTION
180-degree cinematic shutter, natural motion blur on hair and fabric, 24fps. No soap-opera 60fps look. Movement should retain the subtle imperfections of real location photography.

LIGHTING
Natural daylight, soft overcast city light, warm direct sunlight, golden-hour rim light, cool mountain mist, practical lanterns and nighttime city illumination. Lighting must originate naturally from the environment.

AUDIO
Premium contemporary travel soundtrack with subtle modern Chinese-inspired textures. Music drives the transitions and rhythm. Keep authentic location sound underneath: train ambience, station announcements, footsteps, scooters, traffic, vendors, cooking sounds, crowd chatter, wind, birds, distant city noise and riverside ambience. Environmental sound should occasionally become prominent during intimate moments.

REALISM
No CGI look, no plastic skin, no beauty-filter smoothing, no extra fingers, no warped architecture, no artificial crowd synchronization, no impossible reflections, no floating objects, no exaggerated depth of field. Realistic skin pores, hair strands, fabric texture, water reflections, atmospheric perspective and human movement.

BRAND CONTROL
The only Adidas branding visible is the existing Adidas trefoil already present on the traveler’s garments. Do not invent additional logos, advertisements, storefront branding or branded products. Do not add watermarks or random UI.

EDITING
Music-synchronized commercial editing without excessive effects. Cuts are motivated by movement, reflections, steam, architectural shapes, walking direction and changes in light. Use clean match cuts and occasional speed changes only when physically believable. Avoid generic AI transitions, artificial zooms, excessive whip transitions and over-edited montage pacing.

CONTINUITY
The traveler remains identical throughout all shots. Preserve face, hairstyle, red Adidas jacket, trousers, sneakers, bag and accessories. Maintain realistic weather and lighting progression from daylight → golden hour → blue hour → night. Each location should feel like part of one continuous journey through China.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET
The final film should look like genuine footage captured by an elite travel filmmaker for a major Chinese tourism/fashion campaign—not a collection of AI-generated beauty shots. The realism comes first; the commercial polish comes from cinematography, color, music, editing and art direction.
extra-436246ebfea8:
This is not the ending you think it is.

Seedance 2.5 on @FishCreativeHQ 

Prompt

Opening (dark, tense, 0–10s)
Dimly lit rustic wooden cabin interior, moody low-key lighting, shadows, cool color grade. Close-up of a handsome man in his late 20s/early 30s: messy medium-length brown hair, light stubble/beard, striking blue-green eyes, tears streaming down his face, raw anguish. He wears a dark charcoal oversized hoodie with metallic jewelry/charms on the chest. He holds a black pistol pointed directly toward camera (first-person feel from the woman’s perspective), hand trembling, face crumpled in grief.

Cut to medium shot: a beautiful young woman with long wavy blonde hair standing in the cabin kitchen (wooden shelves, metal pots, rustic counters). She wears a slightly unbuttoned cream silk blouse and flowing white skirt. Her expression flips to fierce rage — brows furrowed, teeth bared, intense blue eyes locked on him.
Back to the man: he keeps the gun raised, crying harder, then slowly lowers it, arms opening wide in surrender/offering himself, hoodie stretching as he stands exposed. Extreme close-up of his wet face, eyes squeezed shut, tears falling.
Transition & second half (warm, romantic, 11–26s)
Sudden smash-cut to golden-hour sunlight. The same couple tumbling into tall grass and wildflowers, embracing tightly, leaves and petals flying. Warm, sun-drenched color grade, lens flares, shallow depth of field, dreamy filmic look.
They roll laughing in a sunlit meadow filled with yellow wildflowers. Close-ups: her radiant smile, eyes crinkled, his hand gently cupping her cheek; his peaceful closed-eye smile as she leans over him. Soft golden light wrapping their faces.

They run hand-in-hand away from camera through rolling green hills at sunset, her white dress and his light blue shirt catching the wind. Wide tracking shot.
They sit together on a grassy hilltop overlooking valleys, his arm around her, watching a massive orange sun. He kisses the top of her head. Final wide shot: the couple as small silhouettes against a vast pink-orange dusk sky, hills stretching into the distance, wildflowers in the foreground.
Style notes
Cinematic 2.35:1 or 16:9, filmic grain, dramatic contrast in first half, warm anamorphic flares and soft bloom in second half. Emotional, intimate, high-production drama. Slow-motion on key emotional beats (tears, embrace, running). No dialogue, only ambient sound implied (breathing, wind, distant birds). Mood: heartbreak → fierce confrontation → tender memory/fantasy of love.
extra-848a5e5e77b0:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic documentary-style personal home video showing an ordinary summer day in the life of a young Korean man. The footage should feel spontaneous, intimate, imperfect, and genuinely observed rather than performed.
MAIN SUBJECT
The same young Korean man in his early 20s throughout the entire video.
Naturally handsome, realistic skin texture, minimal styling, relaxed expression, slightly tired but peaceful eyes.
He has naturally messy medium-length dark hair with a few strands falling over his forehead and very subtle stubble.
He wears a loose washed-black T-shirt, relaxed olive-beige trousers, worn white sneakers, and a simple silver wristwatch.
Keep his face, identity, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing, watch, and overall appearance completely consistent from beginning to end.
LOCATION
A quiet older residential neighborhood in Seoul during a warm summer afternoon.
Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, rooftop terraces, external staircases, potted plants, laundry lines, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees, concrete walls, small residential courtyards, and distant city sounds.
The neighborhood should feel authentic and lived-in.
No crowds, tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands, or commercial activity.
CAMERA / VISUAL STYLE
Authentic casual personal-video footage captured with an older consumer digital camera.
Handheld camera operated by a friend walking nearby.
Natural camera shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, slight exposure adjustments when moving between sunlight and shade, soft image detail, mild motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly muted colors, imperfect white balance, and natural compression.
The camera operator occasionally reacts a little late, cuts off part of the subject, or briefly loses focus.
No stabilization, gimbal movement, drone shots, cinematic camera choreography, dramatic lighting, slow motion, modern commercial color grading, or polished cinematography.
The footage should feel like someone simply decided to record his friend during an ordinary day.
---
00:00–00:05 — MORNING ROOFTOP
He sits casually on a small rooftop beside an old plastic chair.
A cold bottled drink rests beside him.
He looks quietly across the neighborhood while the wind moves his hair and T-shirt.
He takes a sip, notices something happening in the distance, and smiles faintly.
He briefly notices the camera and gives a subtle nod before looking away.
The camera takes a moment to find focus on his face.
---
00:05–00:10 — WALKING THROUGH THE ALLEY
He gets up and walks downstairs into the neighborhood.
He walks casually through a narrow concrete alley with his hands in his pockets.
He passes parked bicycles, potted plants, laundry hanging from balconies, and old residential walls.
The camera follows several steps behind him.
He occasionally looks back toward the camera but never deliberately poses.
His footsteps remain naturally synchronized with his movement.
---
00:10–00:14 — SMALL EVERYDAY MOMENT
He notices an old basketball resting near a wall.
He picks it up, casually bounces it twice, then takes a simple shot toward a nearby hoop.
The shot misses.
He laughs quietly, shakes his head, and leaves the ball where he found it.
The camera briefly loses focus during the movement and recovers naturally.
No exaggerated athletic movement.
---
00:14–00:19 — LOCAL SHOP
He walks to a tiny neighborhood shop and buys a cold drink.
He exchanges a few natural words with the shopkeeper but the conversation is not clearly audible.
He steps outside, opens the bottle, takes a drink, and leans casually against the wall.
He watches bicycles and pedestrians passing in the distance.
The camera remains handheld and slightly imperfect.
---
00:19–00:23 — SUMMER RAIN
A sudden summer shower begins.
He looks toward the sky with mild surprise.
Instead of immediately running for shelter, he smiles and slowly walks into the rain.
The rain becomes heavier.
His hair becomes wet and falls naturally across his forehead.
He eventually starts running down the alley, laughing genuinely.
He briefly spins around while running, then continues toward a covered walkway.
His clothes become visibly damp.
Maintain realistic rain interaction, wet fabric, wet hair, reflections, and foot contact with the ground.
---
00:23–00:27 — QUIET MOMENT
He reaches the covered walkway and catches his breath.
Rain falls heavily behind him.
He wipes water from his forehead and looks quietly toward the street.
For a moment, everything becomes still.
He notices the camera again.
He gives a small genuine smile, not a posed expression.
---
00:27–00:30 — WALKING AWAY
The rain becomes lighter.
He walks away down the wet residential lane.
The camera follows from behind.
Reflections shimmer across the concrete.
He turns his head once, gives a tiny wave toward the camera, smiles, and continues walking.
The camera remains pointed toward the empty street for a brief moment.
At approximately 00:29, the recording abruptly cuts to black mid-motion.
No fade-out.
---
PHYSICAL REALISM
Maintain believable real-world physics throughout.
Hands, fingers, feet, clothing, hair, rain, bottle, basketball, and background objects must behave naturally.
No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating objects, teleportation, disappearing objects, or sudden transformations.
The bottle remains a separate physical object and never intersects with his face.
The basketball behaves naturally and remains where it lands.
Parked bicycles and background objects remain stationary unless physically moved.
His feet remain properly connected to the ground while walking and running.
Keep the environment and subject consistent between shots.
---
AUDIO
Natural environmental audio only.
Footsteps on concrete, distant traffic, birds, leaves moving in the wind, bicycles, faint neighborhood conversations, shop sounds, bottle opening, basketball bouncing, rain hitting concrete, water dripping from rooftops, and subtle camera-handling noise.
No music.
No narration.
No soundtrack.
No artificial sound effects.
No spoken dialogue is necessary.
---
FINAL FEEL
The result should feel like a forgotten personal recording of an ordinary summer day.
Not a commercial.
Not a fashion film.
Not a music video.
Not a professional cinematic production.
The emotional appeal should come from small human moments: sitting alone, wandering through familiar streets, missing a basketball shot, drinking something cold, getting caught in the rain, laughing, and walking home.
Quiet, masculine, youthful, nostalgic, slightly melancholic, warm, spontaneous, and deeply human.
Prioritize natural behavior, consistent identity, believable physics, imperfect handheld framing, authentic environmental details, and the feeling that the camera happened to be there.
